title: Navigation & route groups
description: Expo Router structure with signed-out `(auth)` and signed-in `(app)` groups, Ephytron-style AuthGate/GuestGate, and a selectable shell (tabs, drawer, or stack).
notes: Select the shell with `radiance add navigation --option shell=tabs|drawer|stack`.
Tabs items are declared in lib/registry/tabs.ts; each entry needs a matching route under app/(app)/(tabs)/ (tabs shell) or app/(app)/(drawer)/ (drawer shell).
Both tabs and drawer shells wrap the chrome group in a Stack so detail routes under app/(app)/ push on top.
Pushed screens must set `<Stack.Screen options={{ title }} />` — Expo Router otherwise uses the file path (`admin/index`).
lib/registry/session.ts ships a permissive stub and is replaced by the auth module with the real session.
AuthGate and GuestGate mirror Ephytron's AuthCheck / FTUE guest redirect pattern.
